profile.headline: Full Stack Developer at Savas Labs
profile.summary: Highly collaborative, detail-obsessed, emotionally intelligent project manager with 9-plus years experience leading teams, overseeing high-profile partnerships, communicating with stakeholders and delivering successful outcomes.

positions.title: Exhibits Project Manager
positions.description:
•	Manage all aspects of creating new Museum of Science exhibits — ideation, development, production, installation — ensuring all goals are met and exhibits are delivered on time and within budget.
•	Lead project teams of up to 20 people, cultivating a collaborative approach and emphasizing open communication.
•	Develop and manage detailed project budgets of up to $6 million.
•	Create, track and modify project timelines ranging from 1 month to 4 years.
•	Advise upper management, the board of trustees, and donors on progress.
•	Serve as the main point of contact with key museum partners. 
•	Coordinate the work of external vendors including budgeting, scheduling and contract execution.
•	Develop and maintain tools and processes to scaffold the team in making consistent progress on project tasks.

positions.title: Exhibits Project Coordinator
positions.description:
•	Worked with project managers to coordinate project progress, team communication, purchasing and budget tracking, scheduling and documentation.
•	Developed a detailed prototyping, fabrication, and remediation plan and helped execute that plan.

positions.title: HR Assistant
positions.description:
• Coordinated stages of hiring process by conducting phone screens, reviewing resumes, scheduling interviews, and checking references.
• Prepared and scheduled interviews, coordinating candidate and hiring manager schedules, making travel and hotel arrangements when needed.
• Assisted the hiring managers on the day of the interview to help ensure a great candidate experience.

positions.title: Museum/Classroom Aide
positions.description:
• Coordinated meetings for the Executive Director, preparing presentation materials for often quickly-assembled Board conferences. 
• Prepared and sent invoices, memos, letters, and other documents for all fundraisers and outside programs.  
• Promoted museum events on local websites. 
• Provided courteous front desk service for customers.
• Sold and processed orders for tickets, memberships, classes, and events in person, online, and over the phone.
• Created an inventory of all supplies used in the classroom allowing the Education Director to more efficiently develop new programs.   
• Processed a high volume of ticket orders for the museum’s key annual fundraising event.

company.name: Hands-on House, Children's Museum of Lancaster

positions.title: Book Seller/Barista
positions.description:
• Increased sales through customer service and persuasive recommendations.
• Utilized store databases to provide customers with appropriate products.
• Restocked and organized books and café supplies.
